evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies transaction locktime handling in src/wallet/spend.cpp and src/wallet/feebumper.cpp.
rationale: Prevents on-chain fingerprinting of Bitcoin Core and Electrum wallets caused by anti-fee-sniping backdating locktimes on RBF replacements below the original transaction's locktime. The issue (#26526) addresses a genuine privacy leak in transaction creation, though empirical data indicates it only affects a small fraction of RBF transactions (<2%) and is reasonably deferrable.
